cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.

mechanism: A frames picnic help as a directed assignment but yields shopping method and check-in timing so B will accept working under A overall plan.
confusable: Unlike ordinary shared chores, A insists on assignment and reporting; borrowed authority must relax the form without replacing direction with equal command.
comparison: A remote shopping brief and final check-in differ from raffle prize choices and public deputy recognition.
seedUse: Use D49-b picnic/half work/direction disagreement with S02-a adopting a requested adjustment. No S06+D49-b repair or seed rebinding is performed.
